name: Colab Platforms Limited
summary: Established in 1989 and headquartered in New Delhi, India, Colab Platforms Limited is a company specializing in information technology, esports, and gaming services. Their extensive suite of solutions encompasses sports marketplaces, content creation, media services, infrastructure development, marketing strategies, and intellectual property management. They also offer expertise in athlete management, smart stadium technology, and digital marketing. The firm, which was formerly known as Colab Cloud Platforms Limited, officially adopted its current name, Colab Platforms Limited, in February 2025.
